summary: Rak Thai Language School runs weekday Thai group courses in morning, afternoon and evening slots, online or at its Ploenchit school, with ED visa support.

facts.label: ED visa
facts.value: Students can apply for an ED visa to stay up to 14 months
facts.quote: With us you can apply for an education (ED) visa that allows you to stay in Thailand for up to 14 months.

facts.label: Class size
facts.quote: Small class sizes of five to twelve students.

facts.label: Price (morning)
facts.quote: Morning courses Classes every weekday 9:00 - 12:00 Duration 1 month ฿8500

facts.label: Price (evening)
facts.quote: Evening courses Classes every weekday 18:00 - 20:00 Duration 1 month ฿9500

facts.label: Teachers
facts.quote: All our teachers are university educated.

facts.label: Location
facts.value: Mahatun Plaza, next to Phloen Chit BTS
facts.quote: Our school is located in Mahatun Plaza building, right next to Phloen Chit BTS station.
